title: The ticket sale bell names the amount, and the sale email links to the Space's Orders tab

source.ref: Owner report 2026-11-27 (project thread: Trace the House of Fates payment)

detail:
Owner report 2026-11-27: Toni got 'A guest bought a ticket to Hypnotic Sound by HOUSE OF FATES' in her bell with no amount, and the email linked only to the event page, so the sale read as a notice with no detail and no way to find it.

DONE 2026-11-27: the bell body ends with the amount ('... for $44') whenever the sale carried one, and a Space-hosted sale's email links to that Space's Orders tab (which lists ticket sales since LIVE-2545) beside 'See who's coming'. Daniel approved updating the two bell-body test pins on the decision card 2026-11-27 16:30Z.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
